description: Returns calldata that converts a USDC amount into GBLIN, a basket of cbBTC, WETH and USDC minted at NAV and redeemable at any time. Two steps: (1) approve USDC to the GBLIN Zap, (2) GBLINZap.buyGBLINWithToken, which swaps the USDC to WETH on Uniswap V3 and mints at NAV with a non-zero minimum output. Free. The mint fee and the yearly management fee are governance parameters read live from the vault, not fixed in this text.

wallet_address.description: User's wallet address that holds the USDC and signs the transactions.

name: invest_usdc_to_gblin

action.description: Always sequential_txs: send the steps one after the other.

expected.description: Shares expected and the minimum applied.

gas_hint.description: Gas limit to set on the Zap step.

items.description: One transaction to send, in order: target, calldata, value in wei, and gas when the step needs an explicit limit. The same call is repeated as to, data and chainId (8453) for wallet batch APIs such as send_calls.
